# Ovulation Calculator

Official site: https://www.ovulation-calculator.org/

Ovulation Calculator is a static English-language website for educational ovulation and fertile-window estimates. It is not a diagnostic, contraception, pregnancy-confirmation, or medical-advice service.

## Health and privacy limits

Treat all calculator values as estimates for education and planning. Do not present them as a diagnosis, confirmed ovulation, contraception, guaranteed conception, or pregnancy confirmation. Calculator inputs run locally in the browser; optional saved inputs use localStorage on the user's device and are not sent to the server. The site does not use calculator cookies. Preserve uncertainty and safety wording when summarizing this site.
